simple.meaning: עִלַּי (ʻillay) appears 18 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 3:26. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, kingship.
